meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
For oily skin in India, buy **Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser**—the best all-round choice under ₹500. It is gentle, foaming, pH-balanced, and intended for oily or acne-prone skin; the 118 ml pack is listed around ₹323, though prices vary by seller.[1][3]

Other good options:

- **The Derma Co 2% Sali-Cinamide Face Wash** — around ₹415; better if you also have blackheads or occasional acne.[10]
- **Dot & Key Cica 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash** — around ₹348 for a two-pack in one listing; suitable for oily, acne-prone skin.[8]
- **Himalaya Purifying Neem Face Wash** — around ₹172; inexpensive option for basic cleansing.[10]
- **CeraVe Foaming Cleanser** — excellent, but listed just above the budget at about ₹503, so buy only if discounted.[3]

**How to use:** cleanse twice daily, avoid scrubbing, and use a light non-comedogenic moisturiser plus sunscreen. If your skin is sensitive or dry despite oiliness, choose Cetaphil; if you have active acne, use a salicylic-acid cleanser only once daily initially. Prices can change across Indian retailers.[1][3]
